description: This is a unit test class for the 'RequireNameValidator' class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for EncounterRole objects to ensure the 'name' field is properly validated for null, empty, or whitespace values and correctness when proper.

classes.name: RequireNameValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the RequireNameValidator validation logic on EncounterRole objects.
